description: This course covers advanced web application development techniques including RESTful API design using JSON and XML; server-side templating with Jade and EJS; frontend frameworks like React and AngularJS for dynamic user interfaces; state management with Redux and MobX; backend development with Node.js and Express; database integration using MongoDB and SQL with ORM tools; authentication and authorization using OAuth2 and JWT; real-time communication via WebSockets; and performance optimization through caching and load balancing. It also explores security best practices, including XSS and CSRF prevention, and standards compliance with HTML5, CSS3, and W3C guidelines.

clos.text: Define RESTful API architecture using JSON and XML for data exchange between client and server.
Describe the lifecycle of a React component and its interaction with the DOM using JSX and hooks.
Explain the principles of OAuth2 and JWT for secure user authentication and session management.
Apply Node.js and Express middleware for routing, middleware chaining, and error handling in web applications.
Implement a real-time chat application using WebSockets and Socket.IO with secure authentication mechanisms.
